Our Mission
EPIC is more than a building.
It's a place to belong.

We believe sports do more than build athletes — they build people. In a region where kids and families have to drive hours for a safe, structured place to compete, EPIC exists to bring that home.

Every court, every field, every open hour is designed around a simple idea: when young people have a place to show up, be challenged, and be supported, they grow stronger — not just physically, but mentally and emotionally too.

We're building a space where confidence replaces doubt, where teammates become family, and where the pressures kids carry off the field are met with community on it. Athletics are the vehicle. Empowerment, wellness, and belonging are the destination.
